description: Ordered islands in the AlphaFold model of the D. simulans CG42404 ortholog, ranked by pLDDT
code:
import requests, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/6811dc4d-ddff-4159-9963-5139baa317dd/provenance"
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def load_af(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(j["pdbUrl"],timeout=300).text
    ca={}; sq={}
    for l in pdb.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            ri=int(l[22:26]); ca[ri]=float(l[60:66]); sq[ri]=AA3.get(l[17:20],"X")
    k=sorted(ca); return np.array([ca[i] for i in k]), "".join(sq[i] for i in k), pdb

pl, s, pdb = load_af("B4QZ29")   # D. simulans, closest AFDB-covered ortholog
open(f"{OUT}/AF-B4QZ29-F1-model.pdb","w").write(pdb)
n=len(pl); print("D. simulans B4QZ29 model:", n, "residues; mean pLDDT %.1f"%pl.mean())

# ordered islands: runs of >=8 residues with pLDDT >= 60
isl=[]; i=0
while i<n:
    if pl[i]>=60:
        j=i
        while j<n and pl[j]>=60: j+=1
        if j-i>=8: isl.append((i+1,j,round(float(pl[i:j].mean()),1), s[i:j]))
        i=j
    else: i+=1
print(f"\nOrdered islands (>=8 consecutive residues with pLDDT>=60) in the {n}-aa model: {len(isl)}")
dfi=pd.DataFrame(isl, columns=["start","end","mean_pLDDT","sequence"])
dfi["len"]=dfi.end-dfi.start+1
dfi["contains_PPxY"]=dfi.sequence.str.contains("PP.Y", regex=True)
print(dfi.sort_values("mean_pLDDT",ascending=False).to_string(index=False, max_colwidth=70))
dfi.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_ortholog_ordered_islands.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nfraction of the modelled tail with pLDDT<50: {(pl<50).mean():.3f}; <70: {(pl<70).mean():.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.8))
ax.plot(range(1,n+1), pl, lw=.7, color="#555555")
m=re.search(r"PP.Y", s); y=m.start()+1
ax.axvspan(y, y+3, color="#E45756", alpha=.9)
ax.annotate("PPPY", xy=(y+2, pl[y-1:y+3].mean()), xytext=(y+90, 92),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#E45756"), color="#E45756", fontsize=10)
for st,en,mp,sq_ in isl:
    if not re.search(r"PP.Y", sq_): ax.axvspan(st,en,color="#4C78A8",alpha=.3)
ax.axhline(50, ls=":", c="grey", lw=.8); ax.axhline(70, ls="--", c="grey", lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("residue in D. simulans CG42404 ortholog (B4QZ29)"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("The PPPY motif is the leading ordered island in an otherwise disordered CG42404 cytoplasmic tail\n(red = PPPY, blue = other pLDDT>=60 islands of >=8 residues)", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
